caption:
It's exam season, and Toto has been glued to his desk for hours. Now his back and neck feel stiff.

The longer you sit, the more your body tends to welcome short movement breaks. Slow breathing and gentle Pilates-style movements between study blocks may ease stiffness and help you reset before the next session.

Hybi's tip: stand up every 30–45 minutes, take five slow belly breaths, round and lengthen your back five times, and squeeze your shoulder blades ten times.
